Subject: MAP resync: new Nimbus CX lead & updated milestones

Carl —

Thanks for the update this morning. I wanted to re-open the MAP after the org change you mentioned and introduce a refreshed timeline and clear roles so we don't lose momentum. Quick context: we paused after the pilot scope changed; with a new CX lead we often need to re-establish evaluation owners and procurement touchpoints.

Proposed agenda for the re-kick:
- Intro: Emma (new CX lead) + internal points-of-contact
- Evaluation scope: what still matters vs. deprioritized items
- Timeline: 6-week target to production pilot or extend?
- Procurement & legal milestones

I've attached a cleaned-up MAP workbook (Redwood_MAP_Nimbus_Health_v3.xlsx) with a suggested milestone cadence. Can Emma confirm primary evaluation owners and any missing stakeholders (Security, IT, Procurement)?

Suggested windows for a 30-min resync: Tue 8/3 9–11am PT or Wed 8/4 2–4pm PT. If neither works, send a couple of times that work for your team.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving again.

—Aditya

Emma / Carl —

Welcome, Emma — great to meet you (virtually). Quick note from our side on roles and what we’ll bring to the table during the re-kick:
- Redwood: Aditya (AE, commercial lead), Marissa (CS lead — evaluation playbook & success criteria), Monica (solutions engineer — technical runbook & test harness), Laura (legal ops — contracting pathway).
- Customer: please confirm primary technical reviewer, who owns security/compliance signoff, and procurement point-of-contact.

I updated the attached MAP workbook with a condensed 6-week milestone plan:
Week 0: kickoff, access, baseline metrics
Week 1–2: test harness + sample workload (Monica leads)
Week 3–4: UAT and performance profiling
Week 5: exec readout + procurement alignment
Week 6: pilot decision / go/no-go

Action items for the resync meeting (we’ll cover these):
1) Confirm evaluation owners and SLOs (performance/latency/cost).
2) Decide on security artifacts required now vs. later (SOC2 extract, logging detail).
3) Procurement timeline & PO / contract triggers.

Proposed 30-min resync: Tue 8/3 9:30am PT — I’ve tentatively held the slot on our side. If that works, we’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

—Marissa

Emma / Carl —

Quick technical note ahead of tomorrow’s slot: when we run the sample workload, we’ll need a small S3 bucket (or equivalent) for logs and a short-lived API key for the sandbox environment. Example checklist below — can Emma or your infra lead confirm owners?

- Sandbox API key (team owner + rotation window)
- S3 bucket or file share for tokens/logs (read-only credentials for us)
- Test dataset: 50–100 representative records, anonymized
- Performance target: 95p latency < 120ms for 512-token sequences (tunable)

Also flagging procurement: if you expect PO-based purchasing, please share approximate PO deadline so we can align contract milestones in the MAP.

Onward — Monica (I’ll include the brief technical runbook in the calendar invite).
